title: Text Colors
definition: Utilities for controlling the text color of an element.
simpleExplanation: The `text-{color}-{shade}` system. Choose a color (red, blue, green), and then choose how dark it is from 50 (almost white) to 900 (almost black).
realWorldExample: Using `text-red-500` for a 'Delete Account' warning message, and `text-green-600` for a 'Payment Successful' message.

intermediate: If you just want pure black or pure white text, what classes do you use?

answers.question: Which is darker?
answers.answer: `text-blue-900` (The higher the number, the darker/heavier the color).

answers.question: Black/White classes?
answers.answer: `text-black` and `text-white` (They don't need a numerical shade).
